description: Retire your listing (-> retired, undiscoverable; frees a slot under the per-provider listing cap) with a provider-signed action {actor_did, action: "retire", listing_id, signature} built and signed by you.

action.description: the provider-signed action object {actor_did, action, listing_id, signature}: signature is an ES256 compact JWS over the JCS-canonical {actor_did, action, listing_id}, signed with YOUR session DID key. actor_did must equal your session DID and action must equal this tool's action

idempotency_key.description: caller idempotency key; replays return the original result

name: retire_listing
